news.title: The case for centralized admissions in graduate medical education
news.summary_en: Centralized application services transformed how students apply to medical school. They gave applicants a single point of entry, standardized how programs receive and review data, and provided comparable information institutions could actually use.

news.title: Nobody’s a loser: What genuine education leaders realize
news.summary_en: My father, Jake M. Schrum, would take me with him to cattle shows and sales. As an impressionable teenager, I treasured these outings mostly to have one-on-one time with my dad, but also, to learn about Hereford cattle and how to judge them.
